variant_comprehensiveness.rationale: The collection demonstrates diversity across six problem format types: multiple-choice (15 samples), true/false (4 samples), fill-in-blank/cloze (2 samples), and error-detection (5 samples). Both positive and negative cases are represented; commutativity is tested with matched operands showing equivalence and mismatched operands showing non-equivalence. Two samples include decorative theming (sample 01022d44c047cfdb8bba with dance theme, sample a20b1055929ad0bed733 with basketball theme) that does not interfere with mathematical content or clarity.
